semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Deerns Spectrum provides engineering solutions for high-performance buildings crucial for semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
summary: Deerns Spectrum Private Limited offers technical consulting and engineering solutions for high-performance buildings, which are essential for semiconductor manufacturing and related processes. Their services support the infrastructure necessary for semiconductor fabrication, packaging, and testing facilities, enhancing operational efficiency and sustainability.

regional_presence.Europe: Deerns has a global presence with offices in 9 countries, including several in Europe, supporting semiconductor infrastructure projects.
regional_presence.United States: Presence in the United States as part of their global operations, focusing on semiconductor facility infrastructure.
